name: jason-armstrong
derived_from: Started from measurements of https://www.archetypeai.io/ (off-white page, near-black ink, light headings, small uppercase mono labels, near-square corners), then changed: Forest green accent, a derived dark theme, house coral kept for error and warning only.

button.usage: Buttons, links and the theme toggle

data.usage: Text in inputs, selects, table cells and toasts

accent.usage: Accent for shapes, bars, borders, arrows (Forest green)

accent-text.usage: Accent for small text (deeper in light: 5.6:1 on the page, 5.1:1 on the hover tint, 4.6:1 on the pressed tint)

soft.usage: Accent tint used for the dark-mode hover fill

warning.usage: Warning and caution: shapes and bars (deep amber, so it stands apart from the coral error)

btn-arrow.usage: Button arrow, readable on both the outlined and the solid button

fpady.usage: Filter panel padding, top and bottom

button.rest: transparent fill, 1px inside outline and text in button colour
button.hover_focus: solid fill in button colour, text in button-text colour
button.pressed: solid fill mixed 82% with page background
button.disabled: rest look at 40% opacity, no hover
button.focus_ring: 2px focus-colour ring, 2px offset (ink on light, accent on dark)

chip_and_pill.note: Static in the gallery. The states apply only to an interactive chip, marked with class is-action. A pill is a chip with class pill (fully round).
chip_and_pill.hover_focus: accent text and border, accent tint fill
chip_and_pill.pressed: as hover with the tint doubled, capped at 24%
chip_and_pill.selected: solid fill in button colour, button-text colour

states.motion: 0.14s ease on colour, background and border. None when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

components.note: Built from the locked tokens on 2026-09-30. Component states reuse the interaction rules under "states".

text_input.font: sans 15px weight 300 (not 200, for legibility while typing)
text_input.focus: outline in ink plus a 2px accent ring, 2px offset
text_input.error: outline in the error colour, plus a 7px error-colour square and ink help text (no small coloured text)
text_input.label: mono 11px weight 300, uppercase, muted

select.note: as text input, with a two-triangle chevron and 34px right padding

table.header: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase, 1px ink rule under it
table.cell: sans 15px weight 300, hairline rule between rows
table.overflow: wrap in a scrolling container on narrow screens

callout.base: surface fill, hairline border, 3px ink bar on the left
callout.error: error-colour bar, doubled error-colour tint fill
callout.title: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase

code.block: surface fill, hairline border, mono 13px weight 300
code.inline: mono at 0.88em, surface fill, hairline border

modal.panel: surface fill, hairline border, 24px padding, close cross top right

backdrop.note: lighter in dark mode so the panel sits on a visible backdrop

modal.actions: ghost text button (ink, accent on hover) plus the standard button

empty_and_error.eyebrow: mono 11px weight 400, uppercase; error adds a 7px error-colour square

loading.skeleton: hairline-coloured bars, pulsing opacity, no pulse when reduced motion is preferred

tabs.tab: mono 12px weight 400, uppercase, muted text; hover ink; selected ink with a 2px accent underline; focus 2px accent ring; disabled 40%
tabs.list: 1px hairline under the row, scrolls sideways on narrow screens

tooltip.panel: button-fill background, button-text colour, mono 11px weight 400 uppercase, 7px 10px padding, 1px radius, 9px arrow

toast.panel: button-fill background, button-text colour, sans 15px weight 300, 12px 16px padding
toast.error: 52px error-colour square flush to the left, top and bottom edges, with a white square-capped cross (18px, 2.4px stroke); replaces the thin bar
toast.action: mono 12px uppercase, underlined, accent on hover
toast.error_note: White on the error colour (coral #ff5c48) is 3.05:1, enough for a graphic (3:1), not for text. The message text stays in the button-text colour.

pagination.item: 32px minimum square, mono 12px weight 400 uppercase, hairline box
pagination.hover: accent box and text with tint fill

navigation.link: mono 11px weight 400 uppercase, ink; numbered prefix in subtle grey (_01)

date_picker.grid: 7 columns of 36px cells, Monday first, weekday row mono 11px weight 300

interactive_edges.note: The rest edge of an interactive chip and of pagination uses the muted outline colour (5.56:1 light, 8.03:1 dark), as form fields do. Static gallery chips keep the hairline.

touch_targets.note: Under a coarse pointer, buttons, fields, tabs, pagination, navigation, interactive chips, toggles, the ghost button, toast controls, modal close and calendar cells are at least 44px (the calendar grid widens to 44px cells). The tuner has a Touch switch to preview it.

theme_switch.default: system (follows the display setting, and updates live if the display setting changes)
theme_switch.control: three icon buttons in one group: sun (Light), moon (Dark), monitor (System). 16px, 1.5px outline icons, 32x30px buttons, 1px radius group. Selected is the solid button fill; unselected hover is accent.
theme_switch.icons_source: The sun, moon-02 and monitor-01 icons from the Vaultia chat app icon map (aws_agent UI/chat/src/app/shared/icon/icon-map.ts). Their upstream licence has not been checked.
theme_switch.memory: The chosen mode is remembered in the browser (localStorage, guarded so the page still works if storage is blocked).
theme_switch.accessibility: Each button has a text label and title; the pressed state is exposed with aria-pressed.
theme_switch.shipped_gallery: The shipped gallery page gets this switch; the tuner keeps its Tune and Touch buttons beside it.

voice.summary: Short, plain and to the point. Explain it the way a patient teacher would, in one line, then stop.
rules: Get to the point in the first sentence.
Keep sentences short. One idea each.
Explain the why in one plain line when it helps, then stop.
Use plain words. If a tool has its own label for something, put the label in quotes.
State facts without hedging. Say 'needs', not 'may need', when the need is real.
Report finished work in the past tense: 'Saved', not 'Saving your changes'.
Say what an action gives the reader, not what happens if they skip it.
End on the next step, not on reassurance.
avoid: filler openers such as 'Welcome to' or 'Here you can'
jargon the reader has to look up

examples.instead_of: Oops! Something went wrong while attempting to process your request.
Simply leverage the filter functionality to refine your results
You may need to grant access before continuing

examples.write: Nothing matched. Try a broader search.

not_when: Brandunity, Vaultia or any other brand or client is named
the work is inside a repo or project that has its own design system or brand
a skill with its own built-in look is running and this brand is not named

sync.note: A bundled copy so the plugin works when installed alone. The master is the theme.json in the jason-armstrong-design-system skill. Do not edit values here: run scripts/check_theme_sync.py --update.
